LMX_MSG_HOST_INGRESS_V0 pin for mixa_manager
=============================================

Purpose:
  App-local pin of the versioned host-ingress seam so mixa_manager does
  not track live stg/l1_baseline/l2src. Include with:
    -I mixa_manager/vendor/lmx_msg_host_ingress_v0
  so #include "l2src/lmx_message.h" resolves here.
